caseNameFull: Cavagnaro v. Clark, Attorney General and Paulekas v. Clark, Attorney General
attorneys: Norman Leonard for applicant in each case., Solicitor General Griswold for respondents in both cases.

opinions.text:
Applications for stays, made to Mr. Justice Douglas, were submitted by him to the Court and denied by it.

Mr. Justice Douglas, Mr. Justice Harlan, and Mr. Justice Stewart would grant the stays.
